answer_1.quote: One effective and simple way to improve crosslingual transfer performance is translate-train, which leverages machine translation techniques to generate pseudo-training data in the target languages by translating source language training data.

answer_2.quote: Extrinsic evaluation implicitly assesses the effectiveness of various label projection methods in generating pseudo-training data for downstream tasks. ... We present the EAE results in terms of argument classification F1 scores in Table.

answer_4.quote: We employ native speakers to assess the accuracy of label translations. The evaluation is carried out using a ranking framework, in which the label translations from each model are ranked, including the option for ties.
answer_4.guideline: The evaluation is carried out using a ranking framework, in which the label translations from each model are ranked, including the option for ties. The final accuracy score represents the average percentage at which the model outperformed all other competitors.
